newsitem.title: USA: Meadow Valley gets $17.9 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Meadow Valley gets $17.9 mln contract.

text.p: Meadow Valley Corp said it received a $17.9 million contract from the Utah Department of Transportation for the construction of a new section of the Bangerter Highway in the Salt Lake City area.

Meadow Valley said since January 1, 1997, it has won bids and been awarded contracts on eight other projects in Nevada and Arizona totaling $23.6 million. These projects range in size from $700,000 to $7.5 million and involve asphalt overlays, new roadways, drainage channels and site work.
These new contracts bring Meadow Valley's June 5, 1997, backlog to approximately $116 million, compared with backlog of $107 million at March 31, 1997.
